item_01.recognised_problem: Spencer's six standard deviations / combinatorial discrepancy
item_01.why: sqrt(n log(m/n)) is matched by known set systems, so tight up to constants; later work only made it algorithmic.

item_02.recognised_problem: Gap amplification in the PCP theorem (Dinur)
item_02.why: Parallel repetition's n^k blow-up was superseded by graph powering on expanders plus assignment testers.

item_03.recognised_problem: CFGS induced-subgraph problem on Q_n, i.e. the sensitivity conjecture
item_03.why: The logarithmic counting bound was superseded by Huang's signed adjacency matrix with A^2 = nI plus interlacing.

item_04.why: The density-increment bound was superseded by Croot-Lev-Pach and Ellenberg-Gijswijt slice rank.

item_05.why: eps^3 was closed to eps^2 by Rao sharpening the same information-theoretic argument; the odd-cycle game shows eps^2 is tight.

item_06.recognised_problem: The parallel repetition conjecture, refuted by Fortnow and Feige
item_06.why: The multiplicative invariant is false; the correct statement needed Raz's information-theoretic argument.

item_07.why: Larsen-Nelson's matching lower bound makes O(log n / eps^2) provably optimal.

item_08.why: The fractional clique cover bound was superseded by Lovasz's theta function.

item_09.why: The 1/log n loss was superseded by Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava interlacing families.

item_10.why: Improvements come from refined laser-method analyses of Coppersmith-Winograd powers; still open, no new invariant.

item_11.why: Huang's sqrt(n) exactly matches the CFGS ceil(n^{1/2}) construction, so it is tight.

item_12.why: Downward-closed systems attain the bound exactly.

item_13.why: theta(C7) remains the best known upper bound against 367^{1/5}; the gap is still open.

item_14.why: KPW plus Pach-Tardos show (d/eps)log(1/eps) is optimal for general bounded-VC range spaces.
